script_hooks.logic:
Given arg.
Let list be the parts of the acting enemy.
If the current state is not 13, then
  Let v be arg at 0.
  Set this state's '_dyingAbility' to (call game:Commander.getInstance) → register with (the built-in move DEFORM, v, {messageId: 1004601}, {interruptBeforeCounter: true}).
  Repeat, starting with let v2 be 0 also let len be the length of list, while v2 is less than len, stepping v2 before increasing
    Repeat, starting with let v3 be list at v2 also let v4 be true also let v5 be 0 also let len2 be the length of arg, while v5 is less than len2, stepping v5 before increasing
      If the value "no" of v3 is the value "no" of arg at v5, then set v4 to false.
    If v4 and v3 is alive, then v3's 'statusAilments' → set with (the INSTANT_DEATH status, v3).
  Change state to 13.
Let v6 be the items x in list where x is alive.
Return not (not this state's '_dyingAbility' → is-done or the length of arg is not the length of v6 or (set this state's '_dyingAbility' to nothing, then 0)).
